answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The nebula graph is validated at intake and the zephyr frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and ocean anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 19 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 137 takes that multiplied out, plus 221 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
